ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Meterpreter/CobaltStrike Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of getsystem Meterpreter/Cobalt Strike command by detecting a specific service starting

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\services\\\.exe$") AND (((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/c.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*echo.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\pipe\\\\.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%COMSPEC\\%.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\,a.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/p\\:.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*MpCmdRun.*"))
